meta.repo: Muhammad Essam (local checkout, Next.js + Tailwind v4)

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Source: --dark-bg (dark) and --background (light, :root).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Solid cards and buttons. Source: --dark-card (Tailwind bg-dark-card).

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Translucent card fill in dark mode (.glass). Dark-card at 70% opacity.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px card border in dark mode (.glass). Primary at 20% opacity.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default foreground and headings. Source: --foreground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand colour: links, highlighted words, primary buttons (label in ink-deep, 7.4:1), focus rings, scrollbar hover. Source: --color-primary. Do not put white text on it (2.65:1).

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Primary hover state and text on light grounds. Source: --color-primary-dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary accent. Source: --color-accent.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Tint of the accent, text selection background. Source: --color-accent-light.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Source neutral. Source: --color-gray.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Body copy, tag labels and secondary icons on dark grounds (Tailwind gray-300 as used in the source).

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Tertiary copy, meta text (Tailwind gray-400 as used in the source).

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Disabled and placeholder text only. Fails 4.5:1 for normal text on surface-page.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the secondary button (hover:bg-gray-700 in the source).

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest near-black used in the source. Not a text colour.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text on surface-card buttons. Not on primary (2.65:1).

tokens.name: red-400

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Error and destructive fills (Tailwind red-500 as used in the source).

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Info accent (Tailwind blue-400 as used in the source).

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp contact button only. Brand colour of a third-party service.

tokens.name: nav-fill

tokens.name: primary-soft

tokens.name: glass-edge-hover

tokens.name: media-fill

tokens.name: field-fill
